snippet.title: Makeruna! Makendou 2 (PS1) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A complete playthrough of Datam Polystar's 1995 Japanese-only 2D versus fighter, Makeruna! Makendou 2 (負けるな!魔剣道2).

This is the Japanese-only sequel to the Super Nintendo game Kendo Rage. "Jo"/Makendo from Kendo Rage is an opponent in the game. I played through the game as Hikari, her little sister.

It was original released on the Super Famicom as Makenruna! Makendo 2: Kimero! Youkai Souri Daijin (負けるな!魔剣道2 決めろ!妖怪総理大臣). It was also released on the PSN as a downloadable "PSOne Classic" in the US and Japan. 

No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
